\section[(dialogue)]{Animals, the body and colours — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R123-first-pass-animals-the-body-and-colours}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for boring and fun.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sentence, a page, music, a film, a song
  \item a drawing, life, a concert, a party, grass
  \item fog, a storm, ice, a rock, a wave
  \item a volcano, a cave, a waterfall, a wood, a donkey
  \item a rabbit, a tiger, a butterfly, a frog, a tortoise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sentence? (\textbf{a frase}.) A page? (\textbf{a página}.) Music? (\textbf{a música}.) A film? (\textbf{o filme}.) A song? (\textbf{a canção}.) A drawing? (\textbf{o desenho}.) Life? (\textbf{a vida}.) A concert? (\textbf{o concerto}.) A party? (\textbf{a festa}.) Grass? (\textbf{a relva}.) Fog? (\textbf{o nevoeiro}.) A storm? (\textbf{a tempestade}.) Ice? (\textbf{o gelo}.) A rock? (\textbf{a rocha}.) A wave? (\textbf{a onda}.) A volcano? (\textbf{o vulcão}.) A cave? (\textbf{a gruta}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{a cascata}.) A wood? (\textbf{o bosque}.) A donkey? (\textbf{o burro}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{o coelho}.) A tiger? (\textbf{o tigre}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{a borboleta}.) A frog? (\textbf{a rã}.) A tortoise? (\textbf{a tartaruga}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R123-second-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a squirrel and an owl.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a squirrel, an owl, a whale, a dolphin, an elbow
  \item an ankle, a wrist, a cheek, lips, the chest
  \item lilac, purple, brown, busy; taken, free
  \item open, closed, calm, noisy, last
  \item famous, important, interesting, boring, fun
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A squirrel? (\textbf{o esquilo}.) An owl? (\textbf{a coruja}.) A whale? (\textbf{a baleia}.) A dolphin? (\textbf{o golfinho}.) An elbow? (\textbf{o cotovelo}.) An ankle? (\textbf{o tornozelo}.) A wrist? (\textbf{o pulso}.) A cheek? (\textbf{a bochecha}.) Lips? (\textbf{os lábios}.) The chest? (\textbf{o peito}.) Lilac? (\textbf{lilás}.) Purple? (\textbf{roxo}.) Brown? (\textbf{castanho}.) Busy; taken? (\textbf{ocupado}.) Free? (\textbf{livre}.) Open? (\textbf{aberto}.) Closed? (\textbf{fechado}.) Calm? (\textbf{calmo}.) Noisy? (\textbf{barulhento}.) Last? (\textbf{último}.) Famous? (\textbf{famoso}.) Important? (\textbf{importante}.) Interesting? (\textbf{interessante}.) Boring? (\textbf{aborrecido}.) Fun? (\textbf{divertido}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
